control: the v16 canonicalised-state walk is re-run on the same cell: every v16 trail cycles at gap 2 (see cycle_channel_v16.json), so the zero here is a property of the declared walk, not of the tracker

pricing.basis: a death kills at most ONE of 2^20 walkers and loses at most that walker's remaining steps; charged at the 95% CP upper bound on the per-trail death rate divided by 2^20
pricing.prior_basis: cycle_channel_v16.json, measured on the CANONICALISED-STATE walk (v16), which is not the declared walk

tracking: exact true-state repeat = cycle; tracking is on because STEPS=1024 <= 2^17
walk: declared v17/v18 walk: step on the true point, canonicalise ONLY the stored key (c,d negated when the key is negated); no walk-state canonicalisation
